name: Canva
description: Canva is a design platform; its developer documentation describes REST APIs authorized with OAuth 2.0 on behalf of Canva users.
notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. Candidate families enumerated from the provider's documentation read on 2026-10-04 (sources canva-dev-7dc1064fcc, canva-dev-e6b9def37d) by an AI agent run; the list is what those pages name, not a complete inventory. Canva-issued credentials (the app client secret, and the access and refresh tokens Canva returns to an app) are kept separate from third-party OAuth credentials; none of the latter are recorded here. The client ID is a public identifier and a benign sibling of the client secret, not a family; it is not yet recorded as a sibling record.
